result.summary: Built the denser office per design REQ-001 4.15 (v3.3) and REQ-007-office-ui (1.0, 1.5, 3.1, 3.6, 4): grid 35 x 22 for 0-21 desks (three columns of 7, extra columns to the left, 40/46/52 x 22), partition cells (kind 'partition', line in the middle of the cell, passage row 9), MIN_CELL_PX = 27 by formula, fitCanvas with fits, labelPlate and plates in step 8, #office-scroll wrapper and canvas 945 x 594, legend band of two lines (2.4375rem) inside the wide @media, fit reads the wrapper. The map of buildLayout(19) is the same as in P28, sign for sign. labelPlate gives the OF-42 values: d=2 w 72 -> null, 72.5 -> {477.75, 71, 76.5, 11}; d=0 94 -> null, 95 -> a plate; buildLayout(1) d=0 130 -> null; d=8 130 -> null; d=18 1 -> a plate; buildLayout(22) d=21 94/95 -> null/plate; w 0 and NaN -> null. Old tests were changed per the 4.15 p.10 table, plus three test helpers outside it (see issues I1). No new tests (LY-13..18, OF-39..42, mutants) were written.

changes.what: Removed the BAY_* constants and leftClosed. New constants MAIN_COLUMNS 3, COLUMN_ROWS 7, MAIN_PLACES 21, COLUMN_PITCH 6, ROW_PITCH 3, GAP_ROW 9, OFFICE_HEIGHT 22. ROOM_BOTTOM is now 20 and ROOM_MAP has 21 rows. DECOR is (6,1) plant, (12,1) shelf, (18,1) shelf, (6,20) plant. deskSpot returns {index, column, row, block, seat, approach}. officeSize returns {desk_count, extra_columns, columns, min_x, max_x, width, height}. Cell kinds follow rules 1-7, with a 'partition' kind at X(j)+5 except row 9. partitions are {x, column, top 1, bottom 20, gap 9}, kept only when both columns are taken. canStep only checks that the target cell is walkable.

New constants FIGURE_TOP 2, FIGURE_BOTTOM 20, LABEL_FONT_UNITS 9, MIN_FIGURE_PX 20 and MIN_LABEL_PX 10. MIN_CELL_PX = ceil(max(...)) = 27. fitCanvas: a bad area gives 27 and fits=false, otherwise max(27, floor(...)), and fits is returned. Partition lines are drawn at x*24+11. labelPlate is new, with the constants LABEL_ASCENT 8, LABEL_DESCENT 3, LABEL_PLATE_PAD 2 and LABEL_PLATE_COLOR. Step 8 measures the caption with measureText (capped at 130) and calls labelPlate; it draws a plate when one is needed, then fillText with unchanged arguments.
div#office-scroll.office-scroll (tabindex 0, aria-label 'Офис — прокрутка') around <canvas id=office width=945 height=594>

New rule .office-scroll {flex: 0 1 auto; align-self: center; min-height: 0; max-width: 100%; overflow: auto} outside any @media. Inside the existing @media (min-width:1240px) and (min-height:640px): .legend {max-height: 2.4375rem; overflow-y: auto}. No new @media; still 15 px lines; .office-inner unchanged.

Starting cellPx is MIN_CELL_PX. fit reads the rectangle of #office-scroll instead of the canvas (gap = legend top - wrapper bottom; the fallback uses offsetTop/offsetHeight of the wrapper; the canvas is used only if the wrapper is missing). decorate sets the wrapper's aria-label from OFFICE_SCROLL_LABEL, the same way as OFFICE_NAME.

LY-01, LY-02 and LY-05 to LY-12 follow the 4.15 p.10 table. LY-01/02 use the formulas of 4.15 p.2, and LY-02 also checks column and row. LY-03 adds 19, 21, 22, 28, 29 and 40. LY-04 is unchanged: it passes with the same cells. LY-05 checks FIXED_CELLS 17x21+4 and the new DECOR. LY-06 checks the partition cells and the 'line iff both columns are taken' rule, with canStep against the partition. LY-07 checks two rectangles (x*24+11, ...) per line, partition cells underneath, and the floor as their base. LY-08 adds 'partition is never walkable'. LY-09 adds partition. LY-11 and its extension use 27 and the numbers from the table, including fits. LY-12 checks 945x594, the canvas as the only child of #office-scroll, and no style attribute.

OF-18 part 4: the grid change is modelled by a createSim step function that closes one cell of the remaining path with the new grid. The test checks that the walker never steps into it, that the path changes, that the walker comes home, and that a closed cell off the path leaves the path the same. OF-20: canvasPoint at min_x 5 (19 desks) and -6 (29 desks). OF-33: partition added to the list. OF-34: buildLayout(29), min_x -6. OF-36: stand 1472x760, legend 90 -> 30, canvas 1050x660; without the legend it would be 34; with one more role, 29. OF-38: cases 41/55/87/85/56 and integers 55. Added the 1472x600 stand -> 27, 945x594. Fonts at 27 and 54. A failure gives 945x594. OF-07: no change. Outside the table: clickCharacter (the helper of OF-10, OF-11 and OF-20) shows the canvas at 24 px per cell, so the clicks stay in logical px (see I1).

PN-12 adds 'empty desk zone 35 x 22'. PN-17 adds office-scroll (div.office-scroll, tabindex 0, aria-label = OFFICE_SCROLL_LABEL before and after start). Outside the table: PN-18 shows the canvas at 24 px per cell for the click (see I1).
setPanelRects and setPanelInts put the stand-in rectangle and offsets on #office-scroll instead of the canvas. This is the stand-in named in 14.2; see I1.

issues.text: I changed three test places that 4.15 p.10 does not name, because the change of the bad-area cell (24 -> 27, E38, OF-38 'сбой') breaks them. First, pixel-office-office.test.js clickCharacter, used by OF-10, OF-11 and OF-20. Second, the click in PN-18. Both counted the click with k=24, which only matched the old default cell. Now the fake canvas is shown at layout.width*24 x layout.height*24, so the click stays in logical px for any cell, with the same strength. Third, pixel-office-helpers.js setPanelRects and setPanelInts: they now set the rectangle and offsets on #office-scroll instead of the canvas, as 4.15 p.8 and 14.2 require ('заменитель прямоугольника #office-scroll'). TEST-DESIGNER should accept or redo these in step 5.
OF-18 part 4 was rewritten per the table. The old 'crossingFree' check (to_cell [13, 4]) became 'a closed cell off the path ([22, 15]) leaves the path the same', as written in the 'after' column.
F2 confirmed in the browser: in 480x800 the width of #office-scroll and of the panel area is 442 px, not 438. The cell (27) and the scrolling do not change.

If the canvas is not supported, #office-scroll stays as an empty focusable element (tabindex 0) next to the note 'Холст не поддерживается'. The project does not say to hide it, so the code does not hide it. Decide in review or design if this matters.

The real caption widths in Chrome are up to 91.4 px in this journal, so they stay below the 94 px threshold of columns 0 and 1. Measured plates are exactly at desks 5, 11 and 18, the same as in the fake canvas.
